feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: U.S. influence in Latin America at stake in runoff election in Brazil
entry.summary: A polarizing presidential election runoff in Latin America's largest economy and biggest democracy pits leftist Lula da Silva's legacy against Trump ally Flavio Bolsonaro, son of the former Brazilian president.

entry.title: An inside look of the massive data center tearing a Wisconsin community apart
entry.summary: In Port Washington, Wisconsin, there's a data center being built that's as big as 500 football fields. Residents aren't sure if it could save their community or destroy it.

entry.title: This center-right former general could unseat Netanyahu as Prime Minister in Israel
entry.summary: A former Israeli general is the main center-right challenger hoping to unseat Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in Israeli elections this week.

entry.title: New Colorado library helps people check out nature, not just books.
entry.summary: A new library in Colorado helps people check out nature, not just books. Library cards give free access to camping gear, nature trails and outdoor experiences.

entry.title: Horror fans on the movies that still scare them
entry.summary: NPR's Brianna Scott and Gabriel Sanchez explain why they love the films that scare them, and have some tips for Halloween watching.

entry.title: Why Wisconsin's tight governor's race matters
entry.summary: The close race for governor in Wisconsin is being watched to see how a candidate back by President Trump does in a state where rural voters have sometimes swung from one party the other.

entry.title: Big name campaign surrogates make final overtures to voters as Election Day nears
entry.summary: With high profile visits from President Trump, Vice President Vance, former President Barack Obama and former Vice President Kamala Harris, the spotlight is on campaign surrogates in the final days before Election Day.

entry.title: Texas voters cast early ballots in key senate race
entry.summary: In Texas, early voting is underway. The state's tight race for U.S. Senate will ultimately help decide the balance of power in Washington.

entry.title: Protests roil France once again as police seek to quell violence
entry.summary: Hundreds of thousands turned out across France to protest everything from the lack of school funding to economic inequality. Police also were out in force to prevent a repeat of last week's violence.

entry.title: New memorial to the 1991 Gulf War opens
entry.summary: President Trump is weighing the possibility of another major attack on Iran. Today, just a few blocks from the White House, military veterans dedicated a memorial to an earlier Middle East conflict: the 1991 Gulf War, which was a military success, but is often overlooked.
